title: Personal Credit Cards: Converting a Checking Shortfall into Points
content:
When Personal Credit Cards points are to restore an overdrawn checking account, the shortfall in dollars is turned into a number of points using the card tier's cash worth per point.

## Rule

The number of points required is the deficit expressed in points at the tier's cash worth per point, any fractional point being raised to the next whole one; when the conversion lands exactly on a whole number, that number is used.

## Worked cases (expressed in point equivalents, hypothetical)

| Shortfall, converted at the tier's cash worth | Points needed |
|---|---|
| 5734.2 point equivalents | 5735 |
| 5735 point equivalents exactly | 5735 |
| 61.01 point equivalents | 62 |

The rounding always goes upward, because a whole number of points short of the shortfall would leave the account still below zero.
